profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Aurify | Python, Unity, C#
profile.summary:
With over four years at Aurify as a Senior Software Engineer, I specialize in game development, leveraging expertise in Unity, Python, and C# to contribute to innovative projects. My role centers on creating engaging and dynamic gaming experiences that align with organizational goals and user expectations.  

Previously, I progressed through multiple roles at AGS - American Gaming Systems, where I gained valuable experience in software engineering and honed my skills in Unity and C#. Motivated by a passion for advancing game development, I continue to seek opportunities to deliver impactful solutions and collaborate with teams to shape engaging digital experiences.
